items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's who I'm talking about right now. George, Will Humphrey, and Faisal, and Lil' Kit Howard...

ctx.x: Okay. Did, what did, did Chris ever say who he liked or what his favorite, who his favorite musicians were or say anybody he liked to play?
That's who I'm talking about right now. George, Will Humphrey, and Faisal, and Lil' Kit Howard, the one that I was telling about. And that's Chris Howard, isn't he? No.
And did he ever say anything about how he liked to play music or how he thought music ought to be played?
